spans.s: kūra, cf. a-kūra-chullaka-vināśi-khaṭvā-vāsa (IE 8-5); explained as ‘boiled rice’; but probably ‘unboiled rice’. The villagers were obliged to supply it to the touring officers of the king. See vodā, siddh-ānna.
kūrma (EI 14), see madhya-kūrma, ‘a plot of land elevated in the middle.’
kuruvinda, cf. kur̤uvindam (SII 2), an inferior ruby.
kūr̤r̤ariśi (SITI), Tamil; obligation of husking paddy belonging to the temple into rice and the charges to be met for the same.
kur̤r̤u-něl, kūr̤r̤u-něllu (SITI), Tamil; tax for husking paddy payable to king.
